lit.\u0027\u003cb\u003e2πr = nλ\u003c/b\u003: "2πr = nλ: the stable orbit holds whole waves."
lit.\u0027\u003cb\u003eEₙ = −13,6 eV·Z²/n²\u: "Eₙ = −13.6 eV·Z²/n²; the levels converge as n increases."
lit.\u0027\u003cp class=\"small\"\u003eMueve:
"

Move the electron (Lab) to calculate a transition.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl electrón recorre \:
"

The electron travels in circular orbits with angular momentum L = n·ħ. The energies are quantized and negative (bound electron). The radii grow as n² and the energy approaches 0 as n → ∞ (the levels converge). Here the radial scale is compressed.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLas transiciones que:
"

Transitions ending at n = 1 form the Lyman series (UV), at n = 2 the Balmer series (visible, Hα = 656.5 nm), at n = 3 the Paschen series (IR). The lines converge toward the series limit (n₂ → ∞).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003ePara \u003cb\u003eion:
"

To ionize (n → ∞) from n = 1, 13.6 eV is needed (λ ≤ 91.2 nm) in H, 54.4 eV in He⁺ and 122.4 eV in Li²⁺: the energy scales with Z² and the radii with 1/Z. The model only works for one-electron systems.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eSi el electrón es una:
"

If the electron is a wave, the orbit is stable only if a whole number of wavelengths fits (2πr = nλ); otherwise the wave destroys itself by interference. This explains Bohr's quantization. The n standing waves of each orbit are shown.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eSubir de nivel exige:
"

Moving up a level requires absorbing a photon of exact energy En₂ − En₁; moving down releases an equal photon (emission). The photon color corresponds to its wavelength; in the UV and IR it is shown with reference colors.

"
